articles.summary: Mirum Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: MIRM), a leading rare disease company, today announced that on October 9, 2026, the Compensation Committee of Mirum’s Board of Directors granted inducement awards consisting of non-qualified stock options to purchase 18,663 shares of common stock and 24,687 restricted stock units (“RSUs”) to 18 new employees under Mirum’s 2020 Inducement Plan. Additionally, the Compensation Committee of Mirum’s Board of Directors granted inducement awards consisting of non-qualified stock options to purchase 40,000 shares of common stock and 25,000 RSUs under Mirum’s 2020 Inducement Plan to the company’s newly appointed Chief Medical Officer, Rob Myers, M.D. The Compensation Committee of Mirum’s Board of Directors approved the awards to Dr. Myers and the other employees as an inducement material to the new employees’ employment in accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4). Conference Call Details: US/Toll-Free: +1 833 461 5787 International: +1 585 542 9983 Access Code: 486697901 You may also access the call via webcast by visiting the Investors section of Mirum’s corporate website. The archived webcast will be available for replay.
